description: This Dart source file defines the ConsultationProvider class, which manages a list of consultations within a Flutter application. It handles fetching data from an API, manages loading and error states, and integrates with authentication and API service classes.

classes.name: ConsultationProvider
classes.description: Manages list of consultations, fetches data from API, and notifies listeners about state changes.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the authentication and API services to the provider.

methods.description: Sets the loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.description: Extracts a list of data from the API response, accommodating different response formats.
